verdict.rationale: The only automation-related versioning in the evidence is Organization Skills, which can be kept in sync with a GitHub repository. That indirectly allows git-based versioning, review and rollback of skill instructions, but not of agents or automations themselves. Artifact version-tracking covers agent outputs, not automation definitions, and nothing documents version history, diff/review, or rollback for agents, triggers or workflows. Missing for 10: native version history for agents/automations, change review or diff tooling, one-click rollback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
